notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). A requirements-elicitation workflow: state a hypothesis with a confidence number, ask one question at a time with a guess attached, restate intent (outcome/user/why now/success/constraint/out of scope), and require an explicit 'yes' before stopping.

Only shapes the conversation. The one possible write is saving the confirmed intent to docs/intent/[topic].md, offered to the user and done 'only if they confirm' (SKILL.md:129, 146). It explicitly tells the agent to stop its turn and not invoke tools after confirmation (SKILL.md:130), and not to run in non-interactive contexts (SKILL.md:36). No commands, installs, credentials, or network access.

Mentions sibling skills (idea-refine, spec-driven-development, planning-and-task-breakdown, doubt-driven-development, source-driven-development) as optional downstream hand-offs; they are not required for this skill to work.
